entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return this useless VeloBand and I need to do it now. Your website is a joke and your policies are ridiculous!

I can certainly look into that return for you. I'm sorry to hear you're having a frustrating experience. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?

The issue is your impossible return window! I had a family emergency! My son was rushed to the hospital and needed major surgery. I wasn't sitting around thinking about returning your fitness band, I was dealing with a crisis!
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is okay with your son. I can definitely review your return eligibility. When did you originally receive the VeloBand?
I don't know, over a month ago! Are you going to help me or not? This is the worst customer service I've ever experienced. Get me your manager right now.

I understand your frustration, and I'm confident I can resolve this for you without needing a manager. Let me just pull up your account... Okay, I see the delivery date here. It looks like you received it 43 days ago.
See! So now you're going to tell me I'm out of luck because of some 10 or 20 day rule while I was dealing with a real emergency? Unbelievable.

Not at all. I'm looking at our return policy right here, and it states that all items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. Since you're at day 43, you are unfortunately outside that window. I can approve this for a full refund immediately.
Wait... really? The website said something completely different. Well... fine. Good. That's what should have happened in the first place.

I apologize for any conflicting information you may have seen. I'm processing the return now and I've just sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. You'll see the refund processed within 3-5 business days after we receive it.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. I wish your son a speedy recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
